title: pkg/testutils: Implement DiffTest struct, RunDiffTests harness, and TimestampNormalizer (prd001-testutils R1-R5)
description:
deliverable_type: code

required_reading:
  - docs/specs/product-requirements/prd001-testutils.yaml (complete PRD for this component -- all requirements R1-R5 and acceptance criteria AC1-AC6)
  - docs/ARCHITECTURE.yaml (pkg/testutils component description, project structure, and design decisions)
  - docs/specs/test-suites/test-rel01.0.yaml (how cmd/ts tests will consume RunDiffTests and TimestampNormalizer)
  - go.mod (module path and existing dependencies)

files:
  - path: pkg/testutils/difftest.go
    action: create
    note: DiffTest struct, Normalize type, RunDiffTests entry point, binary execution, comparison, and divergence reporting logic
  - path: pkg/testutils/normalizers.go
    action: create
    note: TimestampNormalizer and ComposeNormalizers functions

requirements:
  - id: R1
    text: |
      Define a DiffTest struct with fields: Name (string, used for t.Run subtest name),
      Args ([]string), Stdin ([]byte, nil means immediate EOF per prd001 R1.2), Env
      ([]string, nil means inherit test process environment per prd001 R1.3), ExitCode
      (int, expected exit code), Normalize ([]Normalize, applied in order before comparison;
      nil or empty means no normalization per prd001 R1.4), WorkDir (string, optional working
      directory; empty means use a per-test temp directory per prd001 R2.5), and a file
      expectation field for utilities that write output files instead of stdout (per prd001
      R5.1). Define Normalize as type Normalize func([]byte) []byte. Per prd001-testutils
      R1.1-R1.4.
  - id: R2
    text: |
      Implement binary execution that accepts two binary paths (Go binary under test and GNU
      reference binary), invokes both with identical Args, Stdin, and Env from the DiffTest,
      captures stdout, stderr, and exit code from each independently, imposes a configurable
      timeout (default 10 seconds) using context.WithTimeout, supports an optional WorkDir
      (creating a per-test temp directory when not specified), and produces no output to the
      test process stdout or stderr during a passing test run. Per prd001-testutils R2.1-R2.5.
  - id: R3
    text: |
      Implement comparison logic that applies the DiffTest Normalize function slice (in order)
      to both binaries' stdout and stderr before comparison, compares normalized stdout
      byte-for-byte (any difference is a test failure), compares normalized stderr byte-for-byte
      (any difference is a test failure), compares exit codes exactly (any difference is a test
      failure), and reports divergence with: the DiffTest Args, Stdin content (truncated to 256
      bytes if longer), reference binary stdout, Go binary stdout, reference stderr, Go stderr,
      and both exit codes. Each DiffTest runs as a named subtest via t.Run(test.Name, ...) so
      individual failures are identifiable in go test output. Per prd001-testutils R3.1-R3.6.
  - id: R4
    text: |
      Implement a built-in TimestampNormalizer that replaces common strftime timestamp patterns
      (e.g., "Feb 19 12:34:56" for "%b %d %H:%M:%S", ISO-8601 datetime prefixes) with a fixed
      placeholder string so that ts differential tests pass despite wall-clock differences
      between the Go and reference binary runs. Implement a ComposeNormalizers function that
      accepts a variadic or slice of Normalize functions and returns a single Normalize function
      that applies them in order. Per prd001-testutils R4.1-R4.3 and AC3.
  - id: R5
    text: |
      Implement file-state comparison for utilities whose primary output is a file rather than
      stdout (sponge, cp, mv). The DiffTest file expectation field allows specifying file paths
      whose content should be compared after both binaries exit. Compare file content byte-for-byte
      and report divergence in the same format as stdout divergence (showing both contents and
      the triggering args). Per prd001-testutils R5.1-R5.2 and AC4.
  - id: R6
    text: |
      Export RunDiffTests(t *testing.T, goBinary string, refBinary string, tests []DiffTest) as
      the single public entry point. A cmd/ package defines a []DiffTest slice and calls
      RunDiffTests from a standard TestXxx function with no other setup required. Per
      prd001-testutils AC1.

design_decisions:
  - id: D1
    text: |
      Primary source file is difftest.go, named after the primary exported type DiffTest.
      The file must not be named testutils.go. Per project naming convention in
      ARCHITECTURE.yaml: "Go packages must name the primary source file after the primary
      exported type, not the package name."
  - id: D2
    text: |
      Normalize is defined as type Normalize func([]byte) []byte. DiffTest.Normalize is
      []Normalize (a slice for composition per prd001-testutils R4.3). When nil or empty,
      no normalization is applied (per prd001-testutils R1.4).
  - id: D3
    text: |
      Binary execution uses os/exec.CommandContext with context.WithTimeout for the
      configurable timeout (default 10 seconds). A test that exceeds the timeout fails
      with a clear timeout message rather than hanging the test run. Per prd001-testutils
      R2.3 and AC5.
  - id: D4
    text: |
      RunDiffTests iterates the []DiffTest slice, calling t.Run(test.Name, func(t
      *testing.T){...}) for subtest isolation so individual test case failures are
      identifiable in go test output. Per prd001-testutils R3.6.
  - id: D5
    text: |
      This task produces implementation only -- no test files. Tests for pkg/testutils
      are a separate task. Do not create any _test.go files.

acceptance_criteria:
  - id: AC1
    text: "go build ./pkg/testutils/... compiles with no errors."
  - id: AC2
    text: |
      RunDiffTests is exported with signature func(t *testing.T, goBinary string,
      refBinary string, tests []DiffTest).
  - id: AC3
    text: |
      DiffTest struct has all required fields: Name (string), Args ([]string), Stdin
      ([]byte), Env ([]string), ExitCode (int), Normalize ([]Normalize), WorkDir (string),
      and a file expectation field for post-execution file content comparison.
  - id: AC4
    text: |
      TimestampNormalizer is exported and replaces strftime-formatted timestamp patterns
      (e.g., "Feb 19 12:34:56") with a fixed placeholder string.
  - id: AC5
    text: |
      ComposeNormalizers is exported and combines a slice of Normalize functions into a
      single Normalize function that applies them in order.
  - id: AC6
    text: "golangci-lint runs clean on all files in pkg/testutils/ with no warnings."
